sections.heading: What is SaaS LTV?: Subscription Lifetime Value
paragraphs: SaaS LTV (Customer Lifetime Value) measures the total gross profit a subscription customer generates over their entire relationship with your business .

Unlike eCommerce LTV, SaaS LTV uses monthly churn rate to estimate customer lifespan. According to Churnkey and industry benchmarks, a 3:1 LTV:CAC ratio is the gold standard for sustainable SaaS growth.

bullets.label: Unit Economics
bullets.text: Determine if acquiring customers is profitable at the individual level

bullets.label: CAC Budget
bullets.text: Know how much you can profitably spend to acquire new subscribers

bullets.label: Investor Metric
bullets.text: LTV:CAC ratio is one of the most scrutinized metrics by VCs and growth equity investors

bullets.label: Retention Focus
bullets.text: Shows the direct impact of reducing churn on customer value

sections.heading: How to Calculate SaaS LTV: The Formula
paragraphs: The churn-based SaaS LTV formula is:
For example, if your ARPU is $100/month , with a 80% gross margin and 5% monthly churn , your LTV is $100 × 0.80 × 20 = $100
The customer lifetime (1 / churn rate) in this case is 20 months.
sections.formula: LTV = ARPU × Gross Margin % × (1 / Monthly Churn Rate)

sections.heading: Monthly Churn Rate Benchmarks
paragraphs: Based on data from Lenny Rachitsky and Churnkey (2024-2025):

bullets.text: B2B Enterprise (>1,000 employees): <0.5% monthly / <6% annual is GREAT

bullets.label: B2B SMB + Mid-Market
bullets.text: <1.5% monthly / <17% annual is GREAT

bullets.label: B2C SaaS
bullets.text: <2% monthly / <22% annual is GREAT

bullets.label: High churn warning
bullets.text: >5% monthly means losing ~45% of customers annually

sections.heading: LTV:CAC Ratio Benchmarks
paragraphs: The LTV:CAC ratio measures customer acquisition profitability:
Source: Growth Equity Interview Guide, industry standard benchmarks

bullets.text: Below 2:1: Unprofitable. Customer value doesn't cover acquisition cost
2:1 to 3:1: Break-even. Optimize retention or reduce CAC
3:1 to 5:1: Healthy. The industry gold standard for sustainable growth
Above 5:1: Excellent. May indicate room to invest more in growth

sections.note: Source: Growth Equity Interview Guide, industry standard benchmarks

bullets.label: Reduce Churn
bullets.text: Improve onboarding, customer success, and cancel flow with trial extensions and pause walls

bullets.label: Increase ARPU
bullets.text: Upsell premium plans, add-ons, and usage-based pricing tiers

bullets.label: Target Enterprise
bullets.text: B2B enterprise clients have 10x+ longer lifetimes and higher ARPU

bullets.label: Fix Involuntary Churn
bullets.text: Implement precision retries, dunning emails, and failed payment recovery

sections.heading: Churn Impact on LTV
paragraphs: Small reductions in churn create exponential LTV gains:
A 1% reduction in churn can increase LTV by 25-50% depending on your starting point.

bullets.text: 5% monthly churn → 20-month lifetime
4% monthly churn → 25-month lifetime (+25%)
3% monthly churn → 33-month lifetime (+65%)
2% monthly churn → 50-month lifetime (+150%)
